args.title: Tamarack Components: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
- Newsletter (Tamarack Components): This week's edition covers warehouse automation in 2026, linking to the main article and holding a webinar seat on the topic.
- Main article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
